location.en: Shared apartment on Willow Lane, front door
location.zh: 柳樹巷合租公寓，大門口

goal.en: Meet your new roommate and introduce yourself.
goal.zh: 認識新室友，並做個簡單的自我介紹。

background: front steps of a small shared apartment on a quiet residential street, green wooden door with a brass knocker, a plain doormat, potted herbs by the steps, a bicycle against the wall, afternoon sun

intro.en: Day four. Your apartment is finally ready. You drag your suitcase up the steps and knock on the green door.
intro.zh: 第四天，公寓終於準備好了。你把行李箱拖上台階，敲了敲那扇綠色的門。

intro.en: Footsteps run toward the door. It flies open.
intro.zh: 一陣腳步聲朝門口跑來，門「砰」地打開了。

lines.en: Hi! You must be Kai! I'm Mia, your new roommate!
lines.zh: 嗨！你一定是凱吧！我是米亞，你的新室友！

choices.en: Hi, Mia! Nice to meet you.
choices.tip: 初次見面說 Nice to meet you.，加上對方的名字更親切。

choices.en: Hello, Mia. Please take care of me.

lines.en: Take care of you? Oh no, are you sick?
lines.zh: 照顧你？天啊，你生病了嗎？

story.en: Mia runs to get the first-aid kit. You spend your first ten minutes together explaining that you are perfectly healthy.
story.zh: 米亞衝去拿急救箱。你們相處的頭十分鐘，都在解釋你身體好得很。

fail.why: 「請多指教」直譯成 Please take care of me.，會讓人以為你需要照顧，甚至生病了。初次見面說 Nice to meet you. 就好。

choices.en: Hi. How old are you, Mia?

lines.en: Um... twenty-three? Is this, like, a test?
lines.zh: 呃……二十三？這是什麼測驗嗎？

story.en: Mia answers, but things feel a little awkward. She quietly wonders if you'll ask about her salary next.
story.zh: 米亞回答了，但氣氛有點尷尬。她心裡偷偷想著，你下一題該不會要問她薪水吧。

fail.why: 華人初次見面常問年齡，但在英語國家這算私人話題，一見面就問會很突兀。先打招呼：Hi, Mia! Nice to meet you.

lines.en: Nice to meet you, too! Come in, come in! So, where are you from?
lines.zh: 我也很高興認識你！快進來，快進來！所以，你是哪裡人？

choices.tip: Where are you from? 問國家或家鄉，用 I'm from + 地方 回答。

lines.en: You're coming from Taiwan? Like, right now? Today?
lines.zh: 你正從台灣過來？是說，現在？今天？

story.en: Mia thinks you just flew in this morning and sends you straight to bed. You wake up at midnight, wide awake.
story.zh: 米亞以為你今天早上才下飛機，直接把你送去睡覺。結果你半夜醒來，再也睡不著。

fail.why: I'm come 把 be 動詞和一般動詞混在一起了。說來自哪裡用 I'm from Taiwan. 或 I come from Taiwan.，二選一。

choices.en: From the Harbor Inn, on Harbor Street.

lines.en: Ha! No, I mean which country?
lines.zh: 哈！不是啦，我是問你是哪個國家的人？

story.en: Mia laughs so hard she has to sit down. For the next week, she introduces you to everyone as "Kai from the Harbor Inn."
story.zh: 米亞笑到得坐下來。接下來一整個禮拜，她跟每個人介紹你都說：「這是港灣旅店來的凱。」

fail.why: Where are you from? 問的是國家或家鄉，不是你剛從哪裡過來。回答 I'm from Taiwan. 就好。

lines.en: Taiwan! So cool! I've always wanted to go there. So, tell me about yourself!
lines.zh: 台灣！好酷！我一直很想去耶。來，說說你自己吧！

choices.en: I'm 22. I'm here to study English.
choices.zh: 我二十二歲，來這裡讀英文。
choices.tip: 自我介紹用短句：年齡、來做什麼，簡單又清楚。

choices.en: I'm 22. My blood type is A.
choices.zh: 我二十二歲，血型 A 型。

lines.en: Your... blood type? Should I write that down?
lines.zh: 你的……血型？我需要記下來嗎？

story.en: Mia nods slowly. She isn't sure if you're telling her about your personality or your medical history.
story.zh: 米亞慢慢點頭。她搞不清楚你是在說自己的個性，還是在報告病歷。

fail.why: 台灣人自我介紹有時會提星座、血型，但英語國家的人很少聊血型，聽起來像在講病歷。說說年齡和來這裡做什麼就好：I'm here to study English.

choices.en: Me? Nothing special. I'm very boring.
choices.zh: 我？沒什麼特別的，我很無聊。

lines.en: Boring? Come on, you just moved across the world!
lines.zh: 無聊？拜託，你才剛搬到地球另一端耶！

story.en: Mia tries three more questions, but you keep saying "nothing special." She finally gives up and offers you a cup of tea.
story.zh: 米亞又問了三個問題，你都回答「沒什麼特別的」。她最後放棄，改問你要不要喝杯茶。

fail.why: 謙虛在台灣是美德，但對方說 Tell me about yourself 是真心想認識你，一直說自己很無聊會讓對話卡住。分享一兩件事：I'm 22. I'm here to study English.

lines.en: Awesome! Welcome home, roomie! Want some tea?
lines.zh: 太棒了！歡迎回家，室友！要不要喝點茶？

lines.en: Mia grabs your suitcase and rolls it inside before you can say yes.
lines.zh: 你還來不及說好，米亞就抓起你的行李箱推進屋裡了。

story.en: Mia shows you your room, the tiny kitchen and the sunny balcony. For the first time, Maple Bay feels like home.
story.zh: 米亞帶你看了你的房間、小小的廚房，還有灑滿陽光的陽台。第一次，你覺得楓灣像家了。

notes.explain: 初次見面的標準招呼。對方先說時，回 Nice to meet you, too.

example.en: Hi, I'm Kai. Nice to meet you.
example.zh: 嗨，我是凱，很高興認識你。

notes.explain: Where are you from? 問的是國家或家鄉。I'm from 和 I come from 意思一樣，但不能混成 I'm come from。

example.en: I'm from Taiwan. What about you?

notes.en: I'm 22. I'm here to study English.
notes.zh: 我二十二歲，來這裡讀英文。
notes.explain: 自我介紹用簡單短句就好：I'm + 年齡、I'm here to + 動詞、I like + 興趣。

example.en: I'm 22. I like music and hiking.
example.zh: 我二十二歲，喜歡音樂和健行。

notes.explain: Please take care of me. 聽起來像你需要人照顧。初次見面說 Nice to meet you. 就很得體。

example.en: Nice to meet you. I'm happy to be here.
example.zh: 很高興認識你，我很開心來到這裡。

notes.zh: 初次見面不問年齡、不聊血型
notes.explain: 年齡、薪水、感情狀況在英語國家算私人話題，血型更是幾乎沒人聊。可以聊家鄉、興趣、來這裡做什麼。

example.en: What do you like to do on weekends?
